title: CP 200: minimum wages 2026
summary: For a hire falling under CP 200, choose the class and years of experience before setting the salary. The official amounts below are minimum monthly gross amounts at full-time applicable from 1 January 2026.
body: On scale I, with zero years of experience, the minimums are 2,242.80 € in class A, 2,336.26 € in B, 2,369.30 € in C and 2,555.72 € in D. At ten years of experience, they reach respectively 2,334.52 €, 2,567.80 €, 2,799.16 € and 3,022.34 €.

Scale II concerns active employees with one year in the same company. At ten years of experience, its minimums are 2,397.32 € in A, 2,637.36 € in B, 2,875.48 € in C and 3,105.00 € in D. Refer to the complete line corresponding to the candidate; professional experience does not overlap with seniority at the new employer.

owner.name: SPF Emploi, Travail et Concertation sociale

title: CP 200: indexation as of January 1, 2026
summary: The Social Fund confirms indexation of 2.21% as of 1 January 2026. Verify that the salary stated in the offer and recruitment budget accounts for this adjustment.
body: For 2026, the announced coefficient is 1.0221. The Social Fund indicates that all wages are increased as of January 1, 2026; the review should not therefore be limited to the class minimum.

Use the 2026 scales already indexed without applying the coefficient a second time. For existing pay, have payroll verify applicable indexation and any particular sectoral arrangements. The date retained here is the effective date of the 2026 figures.

owner.name: Fonds social de la Commission paritaire auxiliaire pour employés

title: CP 200: annual bonus June 2026
summary: The annual CP 200 bonus is 330.84 € in 2026. Verify any conversion to equivalent benefit before presenting it in the salary package.
body: The Securex guide of 23 December 2025 confirms the 2026 amount and payment during June. The initial 250 € bonus from the 2015-2016 sectoral agreement is indexed each year.

Bonus payment does not apply when it has been converted to equivalent benefit. Ask payroll which arrangement exists in the company before promising the candidate a cash bonus in addition to this benefit. The stated amount concerns 2026 and must not be automatically reused for 2027.

title: CP 200: eco-cheques and part-time
summary: The CLA provides up to 250 € in eco-cheques per year, paid in June. Part-time arrangements follow precise tiers, not simple multiplication of amount by occupancy rate.
body: Article 4 of the CLA of 9 June 2016 provides, for a complete reference period, 250 € at full-time or from 4/5, 200 € from 3/5 and below 4/5, 150 € from 1/2 and below 3/5, and 100 € below 1/2.

The reference runs from June of the previous year to May of the payment year. An incomplete period results in a pro-rata of actual and deemed benefits under CLA no. 98. The employer informs the departing employee of the amount still due.

Article 5 allows conversion to equivalent benefit by 31 October for the following year, or 31 May before first payment at a new company. It requires written agreement with union representation, or prior notice to employees in its absence. The CLA has been applicable since 1 July 2016.

owner.name: Fonds social de la Commission paritaire auxiliaire pour employés

title: CP 200: classify finance, payroll, and IT roles
summary: The class depends on the actual content of the position. Standard CP 200 roles serve as comparison to write the job description and choose the minimum wage.
body: The sectoral list places accounting employee and personnel administration employee in class C. It places accountant, cost analyst and HR assistant in class D. A commercial job title is therefore not sufficient to determine the classification of a payroll manager.

In IT, the ICT operator and PC technician are in class C; programmer, system operator and database manager are in class D. The employer must compare actual responsibilities and tasks with exemplary functions and level criteria. The legal reference is the classification CLA of 9 June 2016, applicable from 1 July 2016.

owner.name: Fonds social de la Commission paritaire auxiliaire pour employés

title: CP 200: crediting professional experience
summary: The CP 200 minimum wage takes into account experience gained before hiring, including outside the new employer. Collect career information necessary for wage scale classification.
body: Article 3 of the CLA of 9 June 2016 includes actual and deemed services as employee, self-employed or statutory civil servant. To determine years of experience, part-time services are treated as full-time.

Deemed periods include certain leave and incapacity, with limits provided by Article 3. A deemed period cannot be combined with a period of activity or other deemed service. Article 2 provides proportional pay for part-time and scale change the month following when the condition is met. Use indexed 2026 amounts, not historical amounts attached to this CLA.

owner.name: Fonds social de la Commission paritaire auxiliaire pour employés

title: CP 200: mandatory training days
summary: The number of training days depends on company size. For 2026 and 2027, companies with at least 20 employees must provide four individual days per year per full-time equivalent.
body: The 2024-2028 sectoral arrangement provides, in companies with fewer than 10 employees, an average of four days per FTE over each two-year period, of which an average of one individual day per year. Between 10 and 19 employees, the total is 4.5 days per FTE over two years, with the same average individual minimum.

From 20 employees, the trajectory goes from three individual days per year in 2024-2025 to four in 2026-2027, then five from 2028 onwards. Plan this entitlement in onboarding and training budget. Collective days constitute an envelope distributable among employees; this term does not necessarily mean group training. The reference date is the entry into force of the sectoral scheme in 2024.

owner.name: Fonds social de la Commission paritaire auxiliaire pour employés

title: CP 200: organize training with Cefora
summary: CP 200 companies can use Cefora's offering free of charge to train their employees. Schedule training during working hours.
body: The Social Fund reminds employers they must provide training to their employees during working time. They can choose Cefora's free offering, organize training themselves, or use another provider.

For training outside Cefora, the company may request financial contribution, subject to device conditions. This possibility allows skill development planning at hiring, particularly in IT, accounting or payroll. The page is part of sectoral training measures applicable from 1 January 2024; it does not have its own update date.

owner.name: Fonds social de la Commission paritaire auxiliaire pour employés

title: CP 200: access to Cefora and training plan
summary: Since 2024, access to Cefora's services no longer requires registering a sectoral plan. The obligation for an annual plan remains for companies with at least 20 employees.
body: The Social Fund clarifies that all CP 200 companies automatically benefit from Cefora's services and advantages. Do not confuse removal of sectoral registration with removal of the legal training plan.

Companies with at least 20 employees must establish an annual plan under chapter 9 of the Employment deal law. The page indicates filing via transfer.werk.belgie.be and offers a sectoral template. It cites publication, 2 September 2024, of the implementing decree; this date serves as documentary reference. The transitional deadline it mentions for old plans must not be presented as a new deadline in 2026.

owner.name: Fonds social de la Commission paritaire auxiliaire pour employés

title: ITAA: protected accounting and tax titles
summary: Do not assign a protected title to a candidate on the sole basis of their degree or experience. Verify their exact status in the ITAA registry.
body: Articles 4 and 7 of the Act of 17 March 2019 reserve the titles of certified accountant and certified tax advisor to persons registered with these qualifications. Article 9 also protects the titles of accountant and tax accountant.

Articles 4, 8 and 9 specify internal titles for salaried practice. Titles likely to cause confusion are also prohibited. Specify in the offer the quality truly required, and explicitly distinguish a trainee candidacy from a certified member candidacy.

title: ITAA: verify reserved accounting activities
summary: For independent work for third parties, verify authorization to perform reserved accounting activities. Verification concerns assigned tasks as much as displayed title.
body: The ITAA page recalls that activities referred to in Articles 3, 1° to 5°, of the Act of 17 March 2019 are reserved, when performed as self-employed for third parties, to categories authorized by Article 5. These include in particular certified accountants, auditors, certain other accounting qualifications and authorized trainees.

Verify the person and, if applicable, the firm in charge of the assignment in the registry. A tax title alone does not demonstrate authorization for all accounting tasks. Article 117 penalizes illegal use of title and illegal practice. The date retained is 30 September 2020, entry into force of the cited Act, the page having no update date.

owner.name: Institut des Conseillers fiscaux et des Experts-comptables

title: ITAA: search for a candidate in public registry
summary: The public registry allows searching for a person or firm before validating a professional title. Preferably use the member number to avoid homonyms.
body: The tool provides notably filters for member number, person name, firm name, company number, location and title. It specifies that filters reserved for natural persons do not combine with those reserved for legal persons.

Verify qualification and trainee mention. Articles 29 and 30 of the Act of 17 March 2019 organize these registrations. The date retained is entry into force of the ITAA framework, 30 September 2020, not an update date displayed by the engine.

owner.name: Institut des Conseillers fiscaux et des Experts-comptables

title: ITAA: admission and internship agreement
summary: Hiring as an ITAA trainee requires professional admission procedures. The employment contract does not replace registration with the Institute.
body: Article 9 of the Royal Decree of 11 September 2020 provides for submission of the file to the Institute by no later than three months before the admission exam. The file includes notably diplomas, possible exemption requests and a criminal record extract less than three months old, unless the Institute already has it under legal conditions. This requirement applies to the file submitted to ITAA.

Articles 10 and 11 govern access to the exam and its purpose, verification of theoretical knowledge. Chapter 5 provisions organize the internship agreement and conduct. Before promising a recognized internship, verify with the candidate admission, master trainee and agreement. The decree entered into force on 30 September 2020 and includes an erratum published 7 October 2020.

title: Flanders: IT, accounting, and payroll shortages in 2026
summary: The VDAB 2026 list identifies recruitment difficulties in IT, accounting and payroll. It helps target skills truly essential in the offer.
body: The edition published 1 February 2026 includes notably accountant, payroll advisor, software developer, software analyst, system manager, network manager and ICT support worker. Difficulties may stem from the number of available candidates or a mismatch between their skills and needs.

Use findings specific to the trade to adapt recruitment and plan candidate training. The VDAB clarifies that its nomenclature changed in 2026: annual lists are therefore not directly comparable. This document describes tensions on the Flemish labor market; it is not sufficient to establish an exemption from work permit or entitlement to assistance.

owner.name: Vlaamse Dienst voor Arbeidsbemiddeling en Beroepsopleiding

title: IT companies: verify CP 200 or CP 209
summary: Membership in Agoria or the title of developer does not determine the joint commission. Confirm the company's CP before using CP 200 scales.
body: Agoria distinguishes CP 200 companies, associated with its Digital wage cost index, from CP 111-209 companies, associated with Manufacturing. These indices serve price revision clauses for commercial contracts; they do not constitute individual wage scales. This distinction shows why a technology company should not be automatically attributed to CP 200.

The CP 200 Social Fund includes information technology companies among its sub-sectors, when they do not fall under a specific commission: https://www.sfonds200.be/fr/la-cpae-cp200/. The Public Employment Service clarifies that the employer's actual activity, not the employee's tasks or employer affiliation, determines in principle the competent commission: https://emploi.belgique.be/fr/themes/commissions-paritaires-et-conventions-collectives-de-travail-cct/commissions-paritaires-0. Have this assignment confirmed by the social secretariat before pricing the offer.
